newsitem.title: USA: McKesson in pact with Crown Labs.
newsitem.headline: McKesson in pact with Crown Labs.

text.p: Crown Laboratories Inc Monday said McKesson Corp's U.S. Health Care Unit agreed to a three year deal, with renewal options, to distribute Crown's liquid nutritional and dietary products to the home health care, hospital and nursing home markets.

In its initial stages, the agreement is expected to produce revenues of $1.5 million per month, increasing substantially as the products are marketed through McKesson's nationwide distribution system, Crown said in a statement.
In a later statement, Crown said its agreement with McKesson's U.S. Health Care Unit is a best efforts contract.

"While there can be no assurances that estimates in the prior press release can be reached, the previously estimated revenue of $1.5 million per month in the contract's initial stages, increasing substantially as the products are marketed through McKesson's nationwide distribution system, was arrived at based upon discussions between Crown and McKesson regarding their mutual expectations," the company said.
